title: Reset Password
content: Users can reset their password from settings and security section.

title: Create Account
content: Users can create an account by clicking the sign up button and entering their personal information.

title: Contact Support
content: Users can contact support by sending an email to support@example.com.

title: Update Profile
content: Profile information such as name and profile picture can be updated from the profile settings page.

title: Delete Account
content: Users can delete their account permanently from account settings.

title: Change Email
content: Registered email address can be changed inside account settings.

title: Security Settings
content: Users can enable two factor authentication for better security.
